title: Freight Damage Authorization Form
subtitle: Freight Damage: bounds the decision, conditions, and expiry.
description: Freight Damage Authorization Form controls freight unit, packaging, damage area, affected quantity, custody event, and mitigation action by tying each Freight Damage custody, document, or movement decision to the cargo owner / claims authority, a stated boundary, and an expiry. The freight exception coordinator preserves conditions, exceptions, confirmation, and both sides of the handoff.
use_case: Use Freight Damage Authorization Form at trailer, dock, warehouse zone, delivery location, and protected evidence area. Check applicable Freight Damage requirements, list the affected quantity, value, document, route, or custody action, and state its limit. Record whether the cargo owner / claims authority approves, conditions, holds, or declines the request; obtain renewed consent before changing freight unit, packaging, damage area, affected quantity, custody event, and mitigation action scope.
